name: The Helmet of the Three-Pointed Star

system.description:
Restores life to any being slain within the past 24 hours; the revived being may act at once and loses no Constitution (Sec. 413). NOT rechargeable.

Charges: roll d100 when found.

How many exist: said to be ten. Never for sale, though one may sometimes be borrowed from a temple or the Imperium for a mission.
